sentences.en: Pardon the intrusion. My apologies for being late for our meeting.
sentences.zh: 请原谅我们的打扰。我为开会迟到向你道歉。

sentences.en: Sami immediately reported the intrusion to the police.
sentences.zh: 萨米立刻向警方报告了有人闯入。

sentences.en: He was shocked at the intrusion.
sentences.zh: 他对于这次的侵扰感到震惊。

senses.zh: 闯入;打扰 (对某事的)干扰, 干涉
